description: An MCP server that reads a vending fleet's own telemetry: it ingests DEX/UCS-style audit exports (per-selection sales, cash totals, inventory counts, fault events) from local files into normalized read snapshots — every snapshot carrying provenance {machine_id, DEX serial, audit counter, read time} — and serves Tier-0 reads: product-level inventory with staleness flags, sales summaries with the cash vs cashless split, days-to-empty stock-out forecasts (labeled heuristics from measured velocity), and fault reads. v0.1 is phase C0: READ-ONLY, local stdio, no network calls, synthetic fixtures only. The Machine Registry rules the surface: unenrolled machines are invisible, and an ingest whose serial does not match the registry is rejected. PCI law is encoded: the ingest schema has no card-number field, and a PAN-shaped value anywhere in a file rejects the ingest (PAN_DETECTED) without the value ever being stored or echoed. Every ingest and read verdict appends a hash-chained receipt.
